identity.description: Ormas is an Outcomes API for coding work on Bittensor subnet 76, in development. Clients post a change and the test that proves it; miners quote a firm price for the passing result and deliver a branch. Miners will be paid only when independent validators accept the delivery, and clients will be charged the accepted quote and nothing on a miss. Protocol, thin client, reference miner and reference validator: MIT.
identity.additional: Ormas is operated by Heron Cove LLC, which issues invoices and commercial documentation for the service. Registered September 5, 2026; not a continuation of the former subnet 76. Commercial payments and subnet emissions are separate.
